items.q: What is Smart Wafaa and how does it work with Apple & Google Wallet?
items.a: Smart Wafaa is a native loyalty engine. You design a pass once, and customers add it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet with a single tap. Every stamp, point or balance update is pushed to the pass instantly and signed with Apple PassKit and Google Pay certificates.

items.q: Do my customers need to download a separate mobile app?
items.a: No. Passes live inside the wallet app that already ships on every iPhone and Android device. Customers scan a QR code or tap an NFC standee and the pass is saved in under eight seconds.

items.q: Can I combine multiple mechanics on a single card?
items.a: Yes. Layer stamps, subscriptions, prepaid credit, cashback, tiers and discounts onto one pass. The rules engine resolves them at the till so staff only ever see a single customer card.

items.q: How do store staff authenticate and punch customer passes?
items.a: Each cashier gets a personal PIN on the staff terminal. They scan the customer pass with any smartphone camera or barcode scanner, and every action is logged against the staff member, customer and branch.

items.q: How does the Reseller Partner Programme work?
items.a: Agencies and POS resellers get a white-label partner portal, wholesale pricing and recurring commission on every merchant they onboard. Apply from the Partners page and our team will set up your portal within two business days.
